verification_claims.why: The tool log shows the KST signup min 2026-08-03 00:01:35+09:00 and max 2026-09-27 23:41:33+09:00.

verification_claims.why: The log shows 'month differs UTC vs KST: 7'; the 7/27 cohort claim is consistent with the data starting at 8/2T15:01Z, though the log does not show the cohort count directly.
The log shows 44 test_ prefixes, 53 ourapp.kr emails, and 'internal excluded: 97'.

verification_claims.claim: The data runs to 11/1, so the W4 week (10/19) is fully covered even for the last cohort
verification_claims.why: The log shows 'last event week: 2026-10-26', which is consistent with data through early November; the W4 week for the 9/21 cohort is 10/19, which is earlier than that.
